operations.description: sub_587DB0(aPmodelErrorTxt, aA): open/create the model error text log file using two string-literal arguments; a non-null return is a valid file handle.
If the returned handle is non-null, proceed to format and close; otherwise skip the write path.
StringFormatWithNestedIO(handle, aS_4): write the formatted aS_4 string into the open log file.
FileCloseWithLock(v1): close the file handle on the success path.
Returns the handle value on success (the close call result) and 0 on the failed-open path.
